```{r}
seed_list <- c(12345:12369)
```






#note this section is for rec no ipi
```{r}
train.outcomes <- sorting(pt.status,
                          "Adj",
                          "Therapy complete",
                          "Progression")

train.outcomes <- arrange(train.outcomes, desc(Sample))


test.outcomes <- sorting(pt.status,
                        "Adj Validation",
                        "Therapy complete",
                        "Progression")

test.outcomes <- arrange(test.outcomes, desc(Sample))


train.seq <- filter(gene.exp,
                    (Sample %in% train.outcomes$Sample))
train.seq <- arrange(train.seq, desc(Sample))


test.seq <- filter(gene.exp,
                   (Sample %in% test.outcomes$Sample))
test.seq <- arrange(test.seq, desc(Sample))

ordered_rec <- logr_pro_noipi$gene[order(logr_pro_noipi$p.value)]

rec_list <- c("Sample", ordered_rec)

train.seq <- train.seq %>% select(rec_list)
test.seq <- test.seq %>% select(rec_list)



# top.c <- pt.char %>% select(Sample, Therapy, `BMI (kg/m2)`, `Platelets (K/uL)`,
#                             `LDH (U/L)`, Stage, Age)
# train.seq <- left_join(train.seq, top.c)
# test.seq <- left_join(test.seq, top.c)


```

#rec F1 auto opt
```{r}
opt_F1_rec <- data.frame(genes = 79:1, Avg.F1 = NA)

for (i in 1:79) {
rf_rec_top_char <- kTest(seed_list, "Therapy complete", "Progression", "Opt") 

    temp_conmat2 <- data.frame(run = 1:25,
                             F1 = NA)

  for (j in 1:25) {
    temp_conmat <- confusionMatrix(rf_rec_top_char[[j]][[1]][[3]],
                                   positive = "Progression")
    temp_conmat2$F1[j] <- temp_conmat[[4]][7]
    
  }
avg <- mean(temp_conmat2$F1)


opt_F1_rec$Avg.F1[i] <- avg
x = length(train.seq)
train.seq <- train.seq[-x]
test.seq <- test.seq[-x]

Sys.sleep(1)
}

save(opt_F1_rec, file = "../Outputs/opt_F1_rec.Rdata")

rec_bestmodel_list <- ordered_rec[1:2]

save(rec_bestmodel_list, file = "../Outputs/rec_bestmodel_list.Rdata")


```


#rec graph
```{r}

load(file = "../Outputs/opt_F1_rec.Rdata")

ten_rec <- opt_F1_rec %>%
  filter(genes <=10)

rec_gene_number <- 1:nrow(ten_rec)

F1_plot <-ggplot(data = ten_rec, mapping=aes(x = -genes, y = Avg.F1, fill = Avg.F1))+
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks=10, labels = abs) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1) +
    coord_flip() +
    xlab("Number of Genes") +
    ylab("Recurrence Model Performance (Avg F1)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20),  
    legend.title = element_text(size=20), 
    legend.text = element_text(size=15)
    # plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
  )  

   

# ggplot(df,aes(x,y,fill=y))+geom_bar(stat="identity")+scale_fill_gradient(low="blue",high="red")
print(F1_plot)

```

#tox F1 auto opt 
```{r}

opt_F1_tox <- data.frame(genes = 79:1, Avg.F1 = NA)

for (i in 1:79) {
rf_rec_top_char <- kTest(seed_list, "Therapy complete", "Toxicity", "Opt") 

    temp_conmat2 <- data.frame(run = 1:25,
                             F1 = NA)

  for (j in 1:25) {
    temp_conmat <- confusionMatrix(rf_rec_top_char[[j]][[1]][[3]],
                                   positive = "Toxicity")
    temp_conmat2$F1[j] <- temp_conmat[[4]][7]
    
  }
avg <- mean(temp_conmat2$F1)

opt_F1_tox$Avg.F1[i] <- avg
x = length(train.seq)
train.seq <- train.seq[-x]
test.seq <- test.seq[-x]

print(i)
print(avg)

Sys.sleep(1)
}

save(opt_F1_tox, file = "../Outputs/opt_F1_tox.Rdata")

toxadj_bestmodel_list <- ordered_tox[1:35]

save(toxadj_bestmodel_list, file = "../Outputs/toxadj_bestmodel_list.Rdata")


```
